notes: Original CPG 0.21.14 package lifecycle. Candidate overlay; no automatic mainline qualification.
usage.summary: Use bin/gtirb-rewriting-python to run Python with this isolated GTIRB rewriting stack. Target Python source is exact upstream v0.4.1; native dependencies are pinned upstream wheels, not rebuilt from source. Use tools/nop_pass.py INPUT.gtirb OUTPUT.gtirb REPORT.json for the bounded NOP example. Acceptance covers ELF64 x86-64 SysV ABI with 8 integer arguments, not arbitrary binary equivalence or a formal proof. Requires compatible CPython 3.12, gcc/binutils and Linux runtime.
